questions.question: The simple interest on a sum at 3% p.a. in 3 years is ₹315. What is the compound interest on the same sum at 4% p.a. in 2 years, interest compounded yearly?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

SI for 3 years = ₹315

Rate = 3%

**Formula used:**

S.I = PRT/100

C.I = P [(1 + R/100) n - 1]

Where,

S.I = Simple Interest,

P = Principal,

R = Rate, T or n = Time

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

315 = (P × 3 × 3)/100

⇒ P = 3500

Again according to the question,

C.I = 3500 [(1 + 4/100) 2 - 1]

⇒ 3500 [(26/25)2 - 1]

⇒ 3500 [676 - 625/625]

⇒ 3500 [51/625]

⇒ C.I = ₹285.6

**∴ The compound interest is ₹285.6.**

The numbers of class-A, class-B and class-C officers in the office are in the ratio 5 ∶ 4 ∶ 1, respectively. Find the monthly average salary (in ₹) of an officer, all the 40 of them taken together. questions.solution:

In an office with 40 officers, the average salaries of class-A, class-B and class-C officers are ₹600, ₹750 and ₹1,000 a day, respectively.

The numbers of class-A, class-B and class-C officers in the office are in the ratio 5 ∶ 4 ∶ 1

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of elements/Number of elements

**Calculation:**

The numbers of class-A, class-B and class-C officers = 20, 16, 4

Now,

Salaries of class-A = 600 × 20 × 30

⇒ 600 × 600

⇒ 360000

Salaries of class-B = 750 × 16 × 30

⇒ 750 × 480

⇒ 360000

Salaries of class-C = 1000 × 4 × 30

⇒ 4000 × 30

Total = 360000 + 360000 + 120000

⇒ 840000

Average = 840000/40

⇒ 21000

**∴ The monthly average salary (in ₹) of an officer, all 40 of them taken together is 21,000.**

questions.question: The price of kerosene is ₹48 per litre and the price of spirit is ₹30 per litre. In what ratio should the kerosene and spirit be mixed so that the profit after selling the mixture at ₹60 per litre will be 50%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The price of kerosene is ₹48 per litre and the price of spirit is ₹30 per litre.

**Calculation:**

Cost price of the mixture = [60/(100 + 50)] × 100

⇒ (60/150) × 100

⇒ ₹40

Now,

Let x liters of kerosene and y liter of spirit is mixed

So,

48x + 30y = 40(x + y)

⇒ 48x + 30y = 40x + 40y

⇒ 8x = 10y

⇒ x/y = 5/4

So, ratio of mixture would be 5 : 4.

**∴ The kerosene and spirit should be mixed in 5 : 4 ratio.**

questions.question: Pinky can swim 27 km downstream or 15 km upstream in 3 hours. What is the velocity of the current?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Pinky can swim 27 km downstream or 15 km upstream in 3 hours.

**Concept used:**

Downstream = u + v

Upstream = u - v

Here,

u = speed of the object

v = velocity of the current

**Calculation:**

Downstream speed = 27/3

⇒ 9 km/h

Upstream speed = 15/3

⇒ 5 km/h

So,

u + v = 9

u - v = 5

So, 2v = 4

⇒ v = 2 km/h

**∴ The velocity of the current is 2 km/h.**

questions.question: The average of four consecutive odd numbers is 8. If the next odd number is also considered, then what will be the new average of these five numbers?

According to the question,

y + (y + 2) + (y + 4) + (y + 6) = 8 × 4

⇒ 4y = 20

Now,

The last number is 11

Total of 5 numbers = 32 + 13

⇒ 45

Average = 45/5

⇒ 9

questions.question: The diagonal of a rectangle is 20 cm. If its breadth is 12 cm, then what will be its length?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Diagonal of rectangle = 20 cm

The breadth of the rectangle = 12 cm

**Formula used: **

(Diagonal)² = (Length)² + (Breadth)²

**Calculation: **

According to the formula,

20² = length² + 12²

⇒ length² = 400 - 144 = 256

⇒ length = √256 = 16 cm

**∴ The length of the rectangle is 16 cm.**
